items.title: Joe Wilder Part 1 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: I went to the Mastbaum School in Philadelphia with Buddy DeFranco and Red Rodney, and a bunch of guys. And John LaPorta.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. I had a lot of classical training. I went to the Mastbaum School in Philadelphia with Buddy DeFranco and Red Rodney, and a bunch of guys. And John LaPorta.
Oh yeah. What were the opportunities like back at that time for a musician such as yourself?
